name: Dont Give Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to remain steadfast and courageous, trusting that God is always with them, strengthening and upholding them in every circumstance (Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10). The Lord’s plans for His people are good and filled with hope, assuring a future shaped by His purpose (Jeremiah 29:11; Romans 8:28). Christians are exhorted not to grow weary in doing good, for perseverance will bring a faithful reward, as God continues the work He began in each believer until the return of Christ (Galatians 6:9; Philippians 1:6).
